{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Eelie's Luck''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. The Quarren named the craft after [[Eelie]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who got herself into a number of dangerous situations, without ever coming to harm.
